name: MBSF 27 CCW and 30 CCW Chronic Conditions files
description: The CCW Chronic Conditions datasets provide beneficiary-level indicators of chronic conditions derived from Medicare fee-for-service (FFS) claims using standardized CMS CCW algorithms. The CCW has two versions: (a) the 27 CCW Chronic Conditions (2000-2016; named MBSF_CC_YYYY) and (b) the 30 CCW Chronic Conditions (2017-2022; named MBSF_CHRONIC_YYYY). Key elements include the Ever/First Occurrence Date — the date the beneficiary first met the clinical FFS claims criteria of the algorithm (no coverage criteria applied) and Annual Indicators (codes 0–3) reflecting condition criteria and FFS coverage sufficiency. Both versions include all Medicare beneficiaries, with no age or coverage restrictions.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

Overview: • CCW files can be merged with MBSF to obtain beneficiary denominators, geographic, and enrollment information.
• Researchers can choose between two denominator files depending on study goals.
MBSF_MORTALITY_DENOM: • Provides demographics, mortality, and full enrollment history
• Includes beneficiaries with HMO and partial FFS enrollment
MBSF_MEDPAR_DENOM (FFS Only): • Restricts to beneficiaries with continuous full-year FFS enrollment
• Recommended for prevalence/incidence studies requiring full FFS coverage
Join Instructions: • Left join CCW files to denom files using BENE_ID and year
Key Considerations: • CCW chronic condition files include all ages; linkage with denominator files will restrict cohorts to 65+.
• Using MBSF_MEDPAR_DENOM adds continuous-coverage restrictions to ensure complete FFS capture.

name: Master Beneficiary Summary File (MBSF) 27 CCW Chronic Conditions Dataset
description: This dataset contains annual, beneficiary-level indicators for 27 chronic conditions, as defined by the Chronic Conditions Data Warehouse (CCW), with data available from 2000 to 2016. Earliest possible “ever” date in the 27 CCW Chronic Conditions file is January 1, 1999.
